merge.title: Redundant modules (merge)
merge.description: Adds a second PostgreSQL module whose notes restate the first one with identical facts. The detector finds the high profile similarity AND the record overlap, checks for conflicting numbers, and proposes a merge that is only committed if retrieval does not regress.
merge.expected: Proposal: merge PostgreSQL Tuning Notes into PostgreSQL. Run Adaptation Center → Evaluate → Apply.

mixed.title: Overloaded mixed-topic module (split)
mixed.description: Adds three unrelated Python notes (web serving, data analysis, tooling) under one 'Python Notes' module so it grows past the mixed-topic check. KMeans / source boundaries are scored by silhouette before a split is proposed.
mixed.expected: Proposal: split Python Notes into 3 child modules.

shortcut.title: Repeated co-access (shortcut edge)
shortcut.description: Replays a fixed, deterministic 50-query sequence in which Django ORM and PostgreSQL (and FastAPI and Redis) are repeatedly needed together. The pair counters reach the threshold and a co_access shortcut edge is proposed.
shortcut.expected: Proposal: add a shortcut edge Django ORM ↔ PostgreSQL.

compression.title: Budget pressure (normal compression)
compression.description: Ingests two overlapping runbooks (exact duplicate sections, near-duplicates, wordy repeated sentences) and lowers the demo token budget so usage is about 80% — above the 75% threshold.
compression.expected: Duplicates retired, a summary created with provenance, tokens reclaimed.

emergency.title: Emergency cleanup
emergency.description: Same overlapping runbooks with a budget set so usage is about 93%, above the 90% emergency threshold. Pinned and critical records are protected.
emergency.expected: Deduplicate/summarise first, then delete eligible low-value records until the 82% target.
